messages:
maria: Quick sync — PM ask from ACME: they want tenant-scoped embeddings for the pilot. We need to decide: keep for MVP or push to v1? I propose pushing to v1 and shipping a minimal opt-in for MVP. Opinions?

alex: lean to v1 as well. infra and security work looks large. we can add an opt-in `embeddings_lite` for MVP that keeps single-namespace, no tenant KMS.

jamal: customer is pressing — they said security is a hard blocker in the RFP. any chance of a short-term mitigator (isolation docs + signed NDA)?

sophie: if we push to v1 we need concrete v1 acceptance criteria: KMS integration, per-tenant audit logs, and quota enforcement. For MVP: documented limitations + explicit opt-in flag + data residency note.

kevin: timeline reality check — keeping tenant-scoped for MVP adds ~3 sprints of dev + testing. freeze for milestone is end of week. suggest we carve a "pilot canary" post-MVP slice instead of dragging MVP.

maria: proposal: remove tenant-scoped embeddings from MVP. ship "embeddings-lite" in MVP (single-namespace, opt-in). run a guarded pilot in sprint+1 for tenant-scoped v1. objections?

alex: +1. I'll draft the RFC for the opt-in flow and rollout policy. quick config example for the flag: ```yaml
feature_flags:
  embeddings_lite: true
```

jamal: tagging @maria — I'll validate ACME's acceptance criteria verbally today and ask if demo-mode is acceptable for pilot start.

maria: thanks. @prod-bot can you create the follow-up ticket and assign owners?

prod-bot: created ticket RDW-8723 "embeddings-lite opt-in flag" assigned to alex, due next sprint. :white_check_mark:

sophie: add a roll-forward floor: if pilot integration slips >2 weeks, escalate to a minimal dedicated onboarding path and surface customer impact to sales. add to milestone tracker.

kevin: will update milestone tracker + release notes. also recommend a short note in Fri all-hands about the MVP cut and customer expectations. :loudspeaker:

maria: action items: alex = RFC + rollout; jamal = customer verbal OK; kevin = milestone + all-hands note; sophie = add roll-forward clause to PRD. I'll update PRD to reflect MVP cut. Meeting adjourned :)
